name: The Narmada University
description: Nine halls around a yard, and every one of them measuring something.
arrival: It is smaller than the word suggests and busier than the quiet suggests. Nine halls, a yard with a rain gauge in it that has been read twice a day for four hundred and eleven years, and a great many people being careful. Nobody here is a fool. That turns out to matter more than the alternative would have.
notes: The academy as a place rather than a citation. Deliberately sympathetic -- the scholars are rigorous and generous with the player, which is what makes the structural error land.
